source: official Ente Bhoomi public viewer published-village map export
safety: Only parcel_gid and geometry were persisted for viewport features; only parcel_gid and geometry WKT were persisted for the exact lookup. Auth key and non-whitelisted attributes were discarded in memory.

geometryValidation.projection: EPSG:32643 to EPSG:4326 using backend package proj4 2.22.0, rounded to 1e-8 degrees

spatialIntersectionAudit.method: @turf/turf booleanIntersects against EPSG:32643 bbox polygons, using each returned unique feature geometry; topology is CRS-independent for these planar intersections.
spatialIntersectionAudit.explanation: The provider returned a small number of rows whose actual polygon does not intersect a requested box. Those features are single-component multipolygons, so disconnected parts do not explain the extras. Most have envelopes overlapping the box while polygon boundaries do not, consistent with a coarse envelope/candidate filter; one Kozhikode candidate envelope misses by about 1 cm. The exact adapter intersection filter should discard them. Per-quadrant raw ID lists were not persisted, so the per-box counts compare provider raw response counts with geometry intersections over the proven-identical union.
